description: This file manages temporary object directories in a Git repository, including creation, cleanup, environment setup, and migration of pack files and objects.

classes.name: struct tmp_objdir
classes.description: Represents a temporary object directory in a Git repository with associated environment and state.

methods.name: void tmp_objdir_free(struct tmp_objdir * t)
methods.description: Frees resources associated with a tmp_objdir instance.

methods.name: int tmp_objdir_destroy(struct tmp_objdir * t)
methods.description: Destroys a tmp_objdir, restoring the repository's primary source if necessary and removing its directory.

methods.name: void remove_tmp_objdir(void)
methods.description: Callback to remove the temporary object directory at program exit.

methods.name: void tmp_objdir_discard_objects(struct tmp_objdir * t)
methods.description: Removes all objects within the temporary object directory, preserving the top-level directory.

methods.name: void env_append(struct strvec * env,const char * key,const char * val)
methods.description: Appends a value to an environment variable list, quoting if necessary.

methods.name: void env_replace(struct strvec * env,const char * key,const char * val)
methods.description: Replaces or sets a value for an environment variable.

methods.name: int setup_tmp_objdir(const char * root)
methods.description: Creates a subdirectory within the given root for temporary objects.

methods.name: struct:tmp_objdir * tmp_objdir_create(struct repository * r,const char * prefix)
methods.description: Creates a new temporary object directory associated with a repository, setting necessary environment variables and setup.

methods.name: int pack_copy_priority(const char * name)
methods.description: Assigns a priority for copying pack files based on their filename suffix.

methods.name: int pack_copy_cmp(const char * a,const char * b)
methods.description: Comparator for sorting pack files based on priority.

methods.name: int read_dir_paths(struct string_list * out,const char * path)
methods.description: Reads directory entries into a string list, ignoring dotfiles.

methods.name: int migrate_paths(struct tmp_objdir * t,struct strbuf * src,struct strbuf * dst,enum finalize_object_file_flags flags)
methods.description: Recursively migrates pack files and objects from source to destination directories.

methods.name: int migrate_one(struct tmp_objdir * t,struct strbuf * src,struct strbuf * dst,enum finalize_object_file_flags flags)
methods.description: Migrates a single file or directory, creating directories as needed and finalizing object files.

methods.name: int is_loose_object_shard(const char * name)
methods.description: Checks if a filename matches the pattern for a loose object shard.

methods.name: int tmp_objdir_migrate(struct tmp_objdir * t)
methods.description: Migrates objects from the temporary directory to the main object directory, then destroys the temporary directory.

methods.name: const char ** tmp_objdir_env(const struct tmp_objdir * t)
methods.description: Returns environment variables associated with the temporary object directory.

methods.name: void tmp_objdir_add_as_alternate(const struct tmp_objdir * t)
methods.description: Adds the temporary object directory to the list of alternate object directories.

methods.name: void tmp_objdir_replace_primary_odb(struct tmp_objdir * t,int will_destroy)
methods.description: Replaces the primary object database with the temporary one, optionally marking the old for destruction.

methods.name: struct:tmp_objdir * tmp_objdir_unapply_primary_odb(void)
methods.description: Restores the previous primary object database if the temporary directory was used as primary.

methods.name: void tmp_objdir_reapply_primary_odb(struct tmp_objdir * t,const char * old_cwd,const char * new_cwd)
methods.description: Reapplies the primary object database setting after changing directories.

ctags.pattern: /^static void env_append(struct strvec *env, const char *key, const char *val)$/
ctags.signature: (struct strvec * env,const char * key,const char * val)

ctags.pattern: /^static void env_replace(struct strvec *env, const char *key, const char *val)$/
ctags.signature: (struct strvec * env,const char * key,const char * val)

ctags.signature: (struct tmp_objdir * t,struct strbuf * src,struct strbuf * dst,enum finalize_object_file_flags flags)

ctags.signature: (struct tmp_objdir * t,struct strbuf * src,struct strbuf * dst,enum finalize_object_file_flags flags)

ctags.signature: (struct tmp_objdir * t,const char * old_cwd,const char * new_cwd)
